Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.


As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. **Job Summary**

It is a people manager role of a small Vietnam team of supplier quality engineers (SQE) to
  

* Take lead of a team of SQEs to ensure Vietnam suppliers meet Medline quality requirements and goals in mass production phase.
* Develop and manage an independent and high\-performed Vietnam team of SQEs to meet team goals.

***Leadership and team management***

* ### **Support Vietnam quality leader cascade the company goals into team goals and individual goals for SQEs, develop the plan, and provide sufficient support to meet the goals;**
* ### **Support Vietnam quality leader to develop the team of SQEs by identifying and developing talents, and continuously improving team members’ competency through trainings, coaching and practice;**

***Functional business management***

### **Lead Vietnam SQEs to ensure the Vietnam supplier meet Medline quality requirements and goals and maintain the performance in mass production phase by**

* ### **Maintain Vietnam supplier rating and optimize or update the rating system when necessary;**
* ### **Build supplier improvement plan after reviewing supplier performance with team members and monitor execution of the plan;**
* ### **Build the annual vigilance audit plan (focus on product and process control) and monitor execution;**
* ### **Lead team members to collaborate with suppliers on quality issues such as complaints and trends of defects, and ensure actions are taken timely and effectively;**
* ### **Lead team members to coordinate change requests from Vietnam suppliers from initiation to the end like assessing impact to product quality and QMS and implementing the change after approval;**
* ### **Lead team members to monitor the design transfer from product development to mass production, ensure the necessary information are documented and accessible for all the relevant functions;**
* ### **Work with QC/QA team to optimize product inspection criteria and improve the inspection efficiency;**
* ### **Train and develop the existing suppliers on quality awareness, including root cause analysis, quality tool utilization, process control…**

***Other work assigned by manager and as the backup for manager.***

Right around the globe, people are using transportation, buildings, and assets that Graduates at Turner \& Townsend have helped to deliver. * Carefully curated learning journeys
* A blend of formal learning and practical development
* The opportunity to obtain company\-paid professional accreditation
* Mentorship from industry leaders
* Peer to peer coaching
* Flexible ways of working

We do this by working as one with the wider client team including designers, architects, engineers, specialist advisors, contractors, and specialist suppliers.

Your career in cost management will create a foundation for success in the future, learning about the key commercial principles, procurement and buying strategies, commercial mechanisms, and contracting arrangements. You will learn how to intelligently engage with suppliers and deliver success for our clients. You will receive leading, recognised training to become chartered plus wider training in behaviours to become a true leader. Responsibilities as follows:

* To assist in cost management commissions: cost estimates, bills of quantities, value engineering, tendering and evaluation, contract knowledge, change orders and final account close\-out.
* To estimate and produce cost plans.
* To conduct cost assessments and valuations.
* To prepare cost reports.
* To liaise with the project stakeholders.

* Degree in quantity surveying, construction management, engineering or equivalent
* Fresh graduates / graduates with maximum 2 years working experience are preferred
* Knowledge of main cost management concepts, tools and techniques
* Ability to work in a fast paced and high pressure environment as part of a committed team.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Good command of written and spoken English.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.
